title: Legs · Quads, Hamstrings, Calves
warmup: 5 min bike, then 2 light leg-extension sets and 2 ramp-up squat sets.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
instructions: Exhale as you lift the lever forwards and upwards by straightening your legs until they are fully extended.
Hold for a count of two.
Inhale as you return the lever to the starting position by bending your knees.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Safely load the barbell onto your traps and .
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out, core braced, and chest up.
Initiate a basic squat movement hips back, knees bent, ensuring they fall out, not in.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
instructions: Place feet on platform slightly higher than base of sled
Extend hips and knees
Release dock levers

exercises.name: 45° Leg Press
instructions: Take a deep breath, extend your legs, and unlock the safeties
Lower the weight under control until the legs are roughly 45 degrees or slightly below
Drive the weight back to the starting position by extending the knees but don't forcefully lockout

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand up tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells, while keeping your legs straight or only slightly bent.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on the lying leg curls machine, stretching your legs out fully
The roller pad should rest just above the heels, a few inches over your calves
Grasp the support handles on each side of the machine

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand erect by extending hips and knees
Raise heels by extending ankles as high as possible
Lower heels by bending ankles until calves are stretched
